studio.conflict: The project changed. Your edit was not applied. Review the latest revision and try again.
studio.invalidProject: The host returned an invalid project.
studio.applied: Edit saved. Source assets are preserved.
studio.opened: Project reopened. Every accepted edit is saved by the host.
studio.title: 影片工作室
studio.welcomeHint: Import media or generate footage, then assemble an editable timeline.
studio.connection: Connection interrupted. Project and jobs remain on the host. {error}
studio.libraryEmpty: Your imported media and generated takes appear here.
studio.createTitle: Make room for your next story
studio.createDescription: Create a local project, import footage, and build a timeline. Editing works without an AI model.
studio.imported: Media imported. Add it to any compatible track.
studio.localOnly: Studio imports only media served by this host. Remote URLs are not fetched.
studio.chatImported: Chat media is available in this project’s asset library.
studio.importUnsupported: Import probing is unavailable on this host.
studio.assetHint: Drag assets to a track, or use Add. Removing a clip preserves its source.
studio.noAssets: Import video, images, or audio to begin.
studio.vfr: Variable frame rate: output sampled by timestamps.
studio.missing: Source media missing. Relink the original file to preserve timeline references.
studio.relinked: Original media restored. The host verified its content hash.
studio.playbackError: This browser could not decode the media. Download the rendered output or try a compatible browser.
studio.previewEmpty: Build a timeline, then render its preview. Preview and export use the same composition.
studio.sourcePreview: Source preview · timeline effects are not shown here.
studio.renderUnsupported: Local rendering is unavailable on this host.
studio.imagePreview: Add this image to the timeline and render a preview.
studio.renderQueued: Render queued against the current project revision. You can continue editing.
studio.emptyTimeline: Add video or audio tracks, then place media from the library.
studio.dragStale: The project changed during the drag. Review and move the clip again.
studio.splitInside: Place the playhead inside the selected clip before splitting.
studio.frameHint: All edit values are integer project frames. Drag a clip to move it; drag its edges to trim.
studio.linked: Apply timing edits to linked clips
studio.takeHint: Select another library asset’s “Use take” to replace this clip while preserving its placement. The original stays in the library.
studio.selectHint: Select a clip on the timeline to edit its timing, sound, or framing.
studio.compositionOrder: Tracks compose in list order, bottom layer first. Fades affect picture and sound. Timeline audio is mixed at export.
studio.captionUnavailable: Caption rendering is unavailable on this host.
studio.transcriptionUnavailable: Automatic transcription and word-based cuts are not yet available in Studio. Captions remain manually editable.
studio.generateHelp: Native generation runs on this host. New takes remain in the library until you add or accept them.
studio.noModel: No video model capabilities are available. Load a supported video model in the host to generate footage. Imported-media editing remains available.
studio.notLoaded: Load this model in the host before generating.
studio.effectiveDuration: {seconds}s · {frames} frames at {fps} fps. Size uses multiples of {grid}.
studio.temporalGuidance: Image guidance conditions frames in time. It does not promise identity consistency.
studio.keyframesHelp: Each image guides a specific output frame. This is separate from identity references.
studio.keyframeLimit: At most 16 temporal image guides can be submitted.
studio.referencesHelp: Select up to {count} model-supported references. Consistency depends on the loaded model.
studio.quality: These settings are sent as shown. No automatic quality reduction or provider substitution.
studio.conditionRequired: This model requires an image-conditioning asset.
studio.referenceLimit: This model accepts at most {count} reference images.
studio.invalidGuides: Each temporal guide needs an image, an output frame within the shot, and a strength between 0 and 1.
studio.generationQueued: Generation queued. The finished take will appear in the library.
studio.contextChanged: The project changed while preparing the assistant. Review your selection and send again.
studio.sessionUnavailable: The host could not create a dedicated Studio chat session.
studio.projectChanged: The active project changed. The assistant request was not sent.
studio.agentHelp: The loaded chat model inspects this project and proposes edits. Review before applying. Edits use the same commands as the timeline.
studio.agentExample: Trim the selected clip to its first four seconds.
studio.assistantPersistence: TensorAgent uses its saved conversation store. Other hosts retain up to eight recent messages in this browser; project packages exclude chat history.
studio.staleProposal: This proposal is stale. Ask for a new proposal using the current revision.
studio.proposalApplied: Proposal applied and saved as one undoable transaction.
studio.plannedShotsHelp: These are saved plans, not generated footage. Load a video model through the host’s model selector, refresh capabilities, and explicitly start each shot.
studio.shotStarted: Generation started. Track its result in Jobs.
studio.shotNeedsModel: No video model is loaded. The plan is saved for later.
studio.plannedShotQueued: The planned shot is queued. Its requested settings were validated without automatic quality reduction.
studio.streamUnavailable: The host did not provide an assistant response stream.
studio.responseTooLarge: Assistant response exceeded the bounded context limit.
studio.agentStopped: Assistant stopped. Any saved proposal remains available for review.
studio.jobPersistence: Jobs belong to the host. Closing this panel does not cancel them. Interrupted work is reported after restart.
studio.noJobs: No generation or render jobs yet.
studio.interrupted: Restart the operation from its settings. Mid-generation checkpoint recovery is unavailable.
studio.previewStale: Preview is from revision {revision}. Render again to see your latest edits.
studio.dissolveHelp: The overlap becomes a picture and audio dissolve. Clip positions stay fixed. Fade controls remain editable.
studio.deleteAssetUsed: 此素材正被時間軸上的 {count} 個片段使用。刪除素材也會移除這些片段。其他素材及其片段將保留。
studio.deleteAssetUnused: 此素材未在時間軸上使用。它將從此專案的素材庫中移除。
studio.deleteAssetRetention: 可以復原此變更。原始檔案和託管媒體會保留，以支援復原和現有工作；此操作不會釋放磁碟空間。
studio.deleteAssetChanged: 確認刪除期間專案發生了變化，未刪除任何內容。請檢查素材後重試。
studio.assetDeleted: 素材已從素材庫中移除。使用「復原」可還原素材及移除的片段。來源檔案已保留。
